BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE task_test
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS kind varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'single_choice';

ALTER TABLE task_test
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_test_kind_check;
ALTER TABLE task_test
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_test_kind_check
    CHECK (kind IN ('single_choice', 'ordering', 'classification'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_test_group (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    task_test_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task_test(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    source_key varchar(255),
    "order" smallint NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK ("order" > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_test_group_i18n (
    task_test_group_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task_test_group(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (task_test_group_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_group_source_key_unique_idx
    ON task_test_group(source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_group_order_unique_idx
    ON task_test_group(task_test_id, "order");

ALTER TABLE task_test_variant
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS correct_order smallint,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS group_id uuid REFERENCES task_test_group(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT;

ALTER TABLE task_test_variant
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_test_variant_correct_order_check;
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_test_variant_correct_order_check
    CHECK (correct_order IS NULL OR correct_order > 0);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_variant_correct_order_unique_idx
    ON task_test_variant(task_test_id, correct_order)
    WHERE correct_order IS NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
